call_3_gap_and_opportunity_reasoning_ent.strategy_goal: Reason about Call-3 strategic gaps and ecosystem opportunities.

target_project.mission_summary: Deliver deterministic planning and build execution for Optimus Prime.

gap_candidates.summary: Local mission does not expose the missing shared telemetry contract for downstream rollouts.
gap_candidates.visibility_rationale: The telemetry gap appears only when Earth sweep evidence is compared against local planning outputs.
gap_candidates.local_mission_blind_spot: The local mission focuses on build execution and does not mention cross-project telemetry reuse expectations.

gap_candidates.summary: Local mission does not capture runtime handshake obligations needed for coordinated canary dispatch.
gap_candidates.visibility_rationale: The dependency handshake becomes visible only after including runtime orchestrator sweep evidence.
gap_candidates.local_mission_blind_spot: The local mission treats dispatch as local control and omits upstream runtime coordination effects.

opportunity_candidates.summary: Add a deterministic runtime handshake bridge before call-4 execution commits dependencies.
opportunity_candidates.ecosystem_level_benefit: Shared handshake semantics reduce rollout stalls across projects that depend on runtime lease state.
opportunity_candidates.recommendation_rationale: Runtime orchestrator evidence confirms the handshake bridge is a reusable ecosystem concern rather than a local-only optimization.

dependency_effects.effect_summary: Needs runtime-orchestrator to expose lease heartbeat compatibility notes for strategy consumers.
dependency_effects.impact: Explicit handshake coverage lowers cross-project coordination failures during canary runs.

opportunity_candidates.next_step: Capture the lease-heartbeat compatibility contract before Call-4 chooses final execution sequencing.

opportunity_candidates.summary: Define a shared telemetry contract for strategy-to-runtime readiness signals.
opportunity_candidates.ecosystem_level_benefit: Multiple Earth projects can consume a common readiness signal instead of reimplementing status translation.
opportunity_candidates.recommendation_rationale: Shared-observability evidence shows the contract can be promoted without inventing new downstream obligations.

dependency_effects.effect_summary: Requires the observability project to publish a stable readiness schema.
dependency_effects.impact: Schema alignment reduces downstream dashboard drift across Earth projects.

opportunity_candidates.next_step: Draft the shared readiness contract with shared-observability before Call-4 execution artifacts are finalized.

opportunity_candidates.summary: Link runtime handshake state into the shared telemetry contract so dependency blockers surface earlier.
opportunity_candidates.ecosystem_level_benefit: A combined contract lets multiple projects detect dependency blockers before rollout windows close.
opportunity_candidates.recommendation_rationale: The combined Earth sweep shows the telemetry and handshake gaps compound unless both projects align on the same blocker surface.

dependency_effects.effect_summary: Handshake status must remain stable enough for external consumers.
dependency_effects.impact: Stabilized status shapes enable reuse across planners and runtime dashboards.

dependency_effects.effect_summary: Observability dashboards need one additional status dimension for handshake blockers.
dependency_effects.impact: Shared blocker reporting improves escalation quality for ecosystem operators.

opportunity_candidates.next_step: Define the shared blocker signal mapping jointly across runtime-orchestrator and shared-observability.
